title: Enchanted Green Kitchen
description: A detailed illustration of a corner kitchen with green cabinets covered in whimsical line drawings of ghosts, faces, and abstract figures. The yellow refrigerator is covered in colorful smiley face magnets, while a black farmhouse sink sits below a vibrant stained-glass style window depicting a red sun, purple mountains, and stylized human profiles.
